'''ZP-U1''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] and one of three droids created by an eccentric droid engineer on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] with the help of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-aligned individual. The engineer did this in an attempt to prove to the Republic that he could be useful to them, and the individual used the droid to defeat a number of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian Separatists]] in [[Mannett Point]].<ref name="TOR" />
